title.narrative: KE Strengthening of M&E within MOYA

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed IDF project is to strengthen the capacity of the Ministry of State for Youth Affairs (MOYA) in Kenya to: (i) better plancomma supervise and evaluate its activities; and (ii) assure good governance of youth-related interventionscomma through the design and implementation of a results-oriented M&E system. Key Output Indicators Progress made under any resulting grant will be monitored according to these indicators: Indicator 1: Results-oriented M&E system Base Value: At present there is no M&E system in place within the MOYA. Date: 03/30/2008 Target: 2 M&E reports produced by MOYAcomma using the results-oriented M&E system set in place within the Ministry.Date: 05/28/2010 Indicator 2: Increased capacity within MOYA on results-oriented M&E Base Value: To be determined through the institutional capacity assessment report. Date: 07/30/2008 Target: - 30 trained staff on results-oriented M&E (national and provincial level from MOYA and line Ministries working on youth issues)comma also trained to be trainers. - 160 trained people on results-oriented M&E (at district level from MOYAcomma NGOscomma FBOs etc.) Date: 11/30/2008 Indicator 3: Increased Fiduciary Capacity within MOYA Base Value: To be determined through the fiduciary risk assessment report. Date: 07/01/2008 - 10 staff trained in Fiduciary aspects of the IDF activities.Date: 08/01/2008 to: (i) better plancomma supervise and evaluate its activities; and (ii) assure good governance of youth-related interventionscomma through the design and implementation of a results-oriented M&E system.
